{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
data_dedup = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Convert biomarker_final from µg/L (batch B) to ng/mL
# The data dictionary states: 1 µg/L = 10 ng/mL
# Therefore, to convert from µg/L to ng/mL, multiply by 10
# Batch B: multiply by 10
# Batch A: no change
data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = data_dedup['biomarker_final']
mask_batch_b = data_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B'
data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final_ngml'] = data_dedup.loc[mask_batch_b, 'biomarker_final'] * 10

# Verify conversion
print(f"biomarker_final (original) min/max: {data_dedup['biomarker_final'].min():.1f} / {data_dedup['biomarker_final'].max():.1f}")
print(f"biomarker_final_ngml (corrected) min/max: {data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].min():.1f} / {data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].max():.1f}")

# Compute the mean of biomarker_final_ngml
mean_biomarker_final = data_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()
print(f"Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}")"}
